description:
One world entity with its loot. The entity's `slug`, `display_name`, `is_npc`, `npc_hp`, `icon_url` and `loot_source_id` (null when it
drops nothing), plus `drops` - its five likeliest drops (`shortname`, `display_name`, `icon_url`,
`chance_pct`, `amount_min`, `amount_max`) - and `drop_count`, the full number of distinct drops. The complete
table is `/loot-tables/{loot_source_id}`. Cached for one hour.
name: get_world_entity
title: One world entity with its loot
